summary: First testing pass on the Jewellery Shop Management app. Backend pytest suite (29 tests) covering auth, rates, customers, products, sales math, dashboard, reports, settings, users role-gating and audit logs — all 29 passed (100%). Frontend Playwright validation of login (all 4 roles), dashboard KPIs, Metal Rates, Inventory search/filter/validation, Customers, full New Sale flow (customer search, barcode add, live math, payments, complete → invoice), Invoice rendering, Sales History, Reports presets/CSV, Settings, Users role visibility — all core flows work. Frontend/backend math match exactly for the sample gold 22K item (Subtotal ₹62,924.80, GST ₹1,887.74, Grand ₹64,812.54).

issues: Overpayment shows 'Balance Due: ₹-5,187' (negative). Better UX: show 'Change/Return: ₹5,187' and clamp Balance Due to 0.

No visible 'read-only' indicator for sales/accountant — Save button is correctly hidden and fields remain editable in the DOM (not persisted). Consider disabling inputs and adding a 'Read only — admin can edit' banner.
'Users' nav link is shown to all roles; sales/accountant see the page (empty) despite backend gating. Hide nav-users for non-admin/manager.
ESC key does not close modals — only backdrop click or Cancel button. Minor UX.

action_items: (Optional/UX) In NewSale summary and Invoice, when received > grand_total, display 'Change: ₹X' instead of negative Balance Due.
(Optional) Hide nav-users sidebar entry for non-admin/manager and add read-only visual state on Settings for non-admins.
critical_code_review_comments: seed() runs on every startup; the seed sales block uses random data (compute_item with hardcoded 6820/95 rates) — deterministic across restarts only because it early-exits when sales exist. OK for demo.
PUT /api/customers/{cid} doesn't guard against duplicate mobile when editing (only POST does). Low priority.
compute_item / calcItem duplicate math between backend and frontend; keep in sync going forward. Currently identical.
seed_data_creation: Tests created a few TEST_ prefixed products/customers/users via API; app seed already provided 4 users, 10 customers, 20 products, 15 sample sales.
